title: Boqortooyada oo aan la arki karin dhammaadka Boqortooyadii
intro: Taariikhdu waxay taqaanay taliyayaal nooc kasta leh, laakiin dad yar ayaa xukumayay gobol la mid ah kan. Meesha dabayshu lafteedu ay ka jawaabto amarkooda iyo shaqaalaha aan indhaha dhimanayn ay ku shaqayn karin aamusnaan, boqortooyadani waxay ahayd mid ka duwan mid ka hor ama ka dib. Haddana xitaa boqortooyooyinka ugu waaweyn waa inay dhammaadaan - markii tan la sameeyayna, runtu waxay ka soo baxday ilo aad u hooseeya oo aan cidina u malayn inay ka shakisan tahay.
clues: Waxaa Rabbi i siiyay boqortooyo ballaaran, oo laga sheegay bogagga barakeysan.
Waxaan ka dhaxlay xigmad iyo awood weyn waalid iga horreeyay oo si daacadnimo leh u socday.
Anigaa dabaysha amray, oo ujeeddadayda aawadeed ayay u socotay.
Dad aan indhaha caadiga ah arki karin ayaa hoos u shaqeeyay awooddayda, iyagoo dhisaya yaabab aan la barbar dhigi karin.
Ilo naxaas ah oo dhalaalay ayaa ii soo qulqulay, nimco gaar ah oo ka mid ah kuwa uu Alle doortay.
Markii aan ka tagay adduunkan, jidhkaygu wuxuu ku taagnaa ul. Kaliya markii xayawaan yar oo dhulka ka mid ah uu cunay ushaas ayay kuwii hareerahayga joogay ogaadeen inaan dhaafay.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
